human_in_loop_decisions: Every AI-generated content recommendation and evaluation must be reviewed by a qualified teacher before affecting student outcomes and all distress signals require immediate human escalation
strongest_guardrails: Strict topic boundary enforcement and no automatic high-stakes decisions and session time limits for minors and mandatory teacher override capability and parental notification
cross_industry_pattern: AI systems in education share a common pattern: model performance alone cannot prevent harm when vulnerable populations such as minors are involved because governance and human oversight and age-appropriate design are equally critical
